title: Northgate Evening Pottery Workshop
contextEn: A man phones a Canadian ceramics studio coordinator to enrol in an evening pottery class and check studio rules.

script.text: Hello, Northgate Ceramics Studio, Chloe speaking. How can I help you today?
Hi Chloe! I walked past your studio window yesterday and saw the sign for autumn evening pottery workshops. Are spots still open?
Yes, we have just a couple of places left for our autumn term! I can get you signed up over the phone if you like. Could I start with your name?
Sure, it is Marcus Halstead. Let me spell the surname: H-A-L-S-T-E-A-D.
script.ttsText: Sure, it is Marcus Halstead. Let me spell the surname: H, A, L, S, T, E, A, D.

script.text: Halstead, got it. And what is the best phone number to text you if a kiln schedule changes?
Um, it is 416-555-8329... wait, sorry, I reversed the last two digits again! It is 416-555-8392.
script.ttsText: Um, it is four one six, five five five, eight three two nine... wait, sorry, I reversed the last two digits again! It is four one six, five five five, eight three nine two.

script.text: Ending in nine two, thank you. Now, we run two evening courses for beginners: hand-building sculptures, and wheel throwing for functional bowls and mugs. Which one caught your eye?
I originally thought hand-building might be easier, though honestly I really want to make coffee mugs and soup bowls, so let me sign up for wheel throwing.
Wheel throwing is loads of fun once you get the hang of centring the clay. Have you checked the course length?
I think the website mentioned a 4-week taster or a 12-week masterclass?
script.ttsText: I think the website mentioned a four-week taster or a twelve-week masterclass?

script.text: Right, the 4-week taster only runs in July and the 12-week masterclass is for returning students. Our standard autumn evening course runs for 8 weeks.
script.ttsText: Right, the four-week taster only runs in July and the twelve-week masterclass is for returning students. Our standard autumn evening course runs for eight weeks.

script.text: Eight weeks is ideal. And how much is the total fee, including clay?
Tuition is $210, and then there is a mandatory $35 charge that covers your stoneware clay and all kiln firings, so the total comes to $245.
script.ttsText: Tuition is two hundred and ten dollars, and then there is a mandatory thirty-five dollar charge that covers your stoneware clay and all kiln firings, so the total comes to two hundred and forty-five dollars.

script.text: Okay, $245 all-in sounds very reasonable. Do I need to buy my own shaping tools or bring a hand towel?
script.ttsText: Okay, two hundred and forty-five dollars all-in sounds very reasonable. Do I need to buy my own shaping tools or bring a hand towel?

script.text: We supply all carving tools, sponges, and fresh hand towels by the sink. The only thing you need to bring yourself is a heavy apron so you do not ruin your clothes.
Good to know, I have an old canvas apron I can bring. Which evenings do the classes run?
Both sections run from six thirty to nine o'clock, either on Tuesday or Thursday. Let me check numbers... oh, Thursday is already full with a waitlist, whereas Tuesday still has two seats open.
Tuesday evening actually works better for my work schedule anyway, so please put me down for Tuesday.
Done! You are officially in the Tuesday group. It is a nice small class too.
How many people are in each workshop? I thought I counted twelve wheels through the window.
Sharp eye! We do have 12 wheels in the room, though one is for the instructor's demonstrations and one is kept as a spare, so we cap every class at 10 students.
script.ttsText: Sharp eye! We do have twelve wheels in the room, though one is for the instructor's demonstrations and one is kept as a spare, so we cap every class at ten students.

script.text: Ten students gives everyone plenty of instructor time. And on Tuesday evenings, do we come in through the main shopfront on King Street?
Good thing you asked! Our front gallery locks automatically at six o'clock. For evening workshops, walk down the side alley and enter through the rear courtyard door.
Through the rear courtyard, got it. Last question: how soon after the final session can we pick up our finished glazed pots?
Normally we say 10 days after the last class... um, actually, wait, we have two extra-full glaze kiln loads this autumn, so please allow 14 days before pickup.
script.ttsText: Normally we say ten days after the last class... um, actually, wait, we have two extra-full glaze kiln loads this autumn, so please allow fourteen days before pickup.

script.text: Fourteen days is totally fine. Thanks a ton for all the details, Chloe!
My pleasure, Marcus! I will send your invoice link shortly, and we will see you Tuesday night.
